caption: A top-down photo of a bowl of Japanese ramen with deep red spicy broth with chili oil floating on top. Wheat noodles are submerged in the broth, topped with sliced chashu pork. The bowl sits on a table, shot in warm natural light, appetizing food photography.

segments_info.text: The table surface behind the ramen bowl, softly out of focus.
A slice of chashu pork with a soft fat rim and browned white surface.
The deep red spicy broth with chili oil floating on top, with wheat noodles just under the surface.
A ceramic ramen bowl seen from above, its glazed rim catching the light.
